content.json:
# Zscaler ASIM Overview and Ingestion Health

Consolidated view of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) activity normalized into Microsoft Sentinel through the Advanced Security Information Model (ASIM). All panels query the ASIM unifying parsers `_Im_WebSession`, `_Im_Dns`, `_Im_NetworkSession`, `_Im_Authentication`, and `_Im_AuditEvent` filtered to `EventVendor == 'Zscaler'`; no raw Zscaler or Cribl-specific tables are queried. Use this workbook to confirm the Cribl-to-ASIM pipeline is healthy before relying on the ZIA and ZPA detail workbooks.

parameters.label: Workspace
parameters.query:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| project id, name

content.json:
## Ingestion Health
Confirms that Cribl is delivering Zscaler events and that ASIM parsers are returning normalized rows.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (_Im_WebSession
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
    | summarize Count=count()
    | extend Metric = 'Web Sessions (ZIA)'),
    (_Im_Dns
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
    | summarize Count=count()
    | extend Metric = 'DNS Queries (ZIA)'),
    (_Im_NetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
    | summarize Count=count()
    | extend Metric = 'Network Sessions'),
    (_Im_Authentication
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
    | summarize Count=count()
    | extend Metric = 'Authentication Events (ZPA)'),
    (_Im_AuditEvent
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
    | summarize Count=count()
    | extend Metric = 'Audit Events (ZPA)')
| project Metric, Count

union isfuzzy=true
    (_Im_WebSession
    | where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
    | summarize LastEvent=max(TimeGenerated)
    | extend Parser = '_Im_WebSession'),
    (_Im_Dns
    | where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
    | summarize LastEvent=max(TimeGenerated)
    | extend Parser = '_Im_Dns'),
    (_Im_NetworkSession
    | where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
    | summarize LastEvent=max(TimeGenerated)
    | extend Parser = '_Im_NetworkSession'),
    (_Im_Authentication
    | where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
    | summarize LastEvent=max(TimeGenerated)
    | extend Parser = '_Im_Authentication'),
    (_Im_AuditEvent
    | where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
    | summarize LastEvent=max(TimeGenerated)
    | extend Parser = '_Im_AuditEvent')
| extend MinutesSinceLastEvent = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastEvent)
| extend IngestionStatus = case(
    isnull(LastEvent), 'No data seen',
    MinutesSinceLastEvent <= 60, 'Healthy',
    MinutesSinceLastEvent <= 24 * 60, 'Delayed',
    'Stale or not ingesting')
| project Parser, LastEvent, MinutesSinceLastEvent, IngestionStatus
| order by Parser asc

union isfuzzy=true
    (_Im_WebSession
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
    | extend Parser = '_Im_WebSession'),
    (_Im_Dns

Web proxy and DNS activity for Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), normalized through ASIM. Web panels query `_Im_WebSession`; DNS panels query `_Im_Dns`. All queries filter on `EventVendor == 'Zscaler'` and use only standard ASIM fields.

content.json: ## Web Proxy Activity (_Im_WebSession)

content.query:
let base = _Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler';
union isfuzzy=true
    (base | summarize Count=count() | extend Metric='Total Requests'),
    (base | where EventResult == 'Failure' | summarize Count=count() | extend Metric='Blocked Requests'),
    (base | summarize Count=dcount(SrcUsername) | extend Metric='Unique Users'),
    (base | summarize Count=dcount(Url) | extend Metric='Unique Domains'),
    (base | summarize Count=sum(NetworkBytes) | extend Metric='Total Bytes')
| project Metric, Count

_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| summarize EventCount=count() by EventResult, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where isnotempty(Url)
| summarize RequestCount=count(), BlockedCount=countif(EventResult == 'Failure') by Url
| top 10 by RequestCount desc

_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventResult == 'Failure'
| where isnotempty(ThreatCategory)
| summarize BlockedCount=count() by ThreatCategory
| top 10 by BlockedCount desc

_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where isnotempty(SrcUsername)
| summarize RequestCount=count(), BlockedCount=countif(EventResult == 'Failure') by SrcUsername
| top 10 by RequestCount desc

_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where isnotempty(SrcIpAddr)
| summarize RequestCount=count() by SrcIpAddr
| top 10 by RequestCount desc

_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| extend HttpStatusCode=coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('HttpStatusCode','')),tostring(column_ifexists('HttpStatusCode_string','')),tostring(column_ifexists('HttpStatusCode_int',int(null))),tostring(AdditionalFields['HttpStatusCode']))
| where isnotempty(HttpStatusCode)
| summarize RequestCount=count() by HttpStatusCode
| top 10 by RequestCount desc

_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where isnotempty(HttpUserAgent)
| summarize RequestCount=count() by HttpUserAgent
| top 10 by RequestCount desc

# Zscaler Admin Audit Overview — ASIM parity

Normalized Zscaler Internet Access telemetry delivered exclusively through Cribl.
